title: The Rev. John Henry Lloyd
dates: (b. Essex 1846/7)
---

Vicar of Fotheringhay, husband of Katie Johns

He was educated at Chichester Theological College 1869-71, deacon 1871, priest 1872, curate of St.

Michael Lichfield 1871-2, of Maulden, Ampthill 1875, of Clifton Biggleswade 1877-8.

He married (1873) Ann Catherine Johns.

He was curate in charge of Wormleighton 1880-1 and vicar of Fotheringay 1881-1890, but had no cure by the 1891 volume of Crockfords, and was perhaps living apart from his wife.

He disappears from the Clergy List c. 1900, reappears 1907, but is more continuous in Crockfords; he lived at 90 Canonbury Avenue until about 1933. [Crockfords, Clergy List, census returns 1871, 81, 91]
